+Use the existing `completedReductionCoefficient X d` as the common coefficient presentation
+for completed reduction and adic towers. Both definitions reduce to the same limit of the
+same quotient diagram. The former separate spelling forces repeated conversions through
+the limit construction while elaborating long derived-category proofs. Canonicalizing the
+alias allows the completed coefficient to remain behind its API. This repairs compilation
+cost without changing any coefficient object, public signature, target, or mathematical
+statement. The item also uses local irreducibility and explicit API equations, rather than
+unfolding the chosen scalar-extension or derived-adjunction witnesses. The repair
+further restricts completed-coefficient unfolding in the integral-coefficient section
+to the uniformizer theorem: the constructibility and counterexample proofs use the
+coefficient API without unfolding the inverse limit.
+
+`Sheaf.Paper.BoundedConstructibleTower` is unclaimed at the consumer check. The only change
+to that module is the body below. In particular, `pbcAdicRings` stays unchanged. The former
+and new bodies are definitionally equal (`rfl`), so every consumer still has exactly the
+same statement. Targets using this definition are flagged for the ordinary independent
+semantic review; their meaning is unchanged. No source-library module is modified.
+
+## Old
+
+```lean
+abbrev pbcAdicCompletion (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
+    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) :=
+  AdicCoefficients.completedRing X d.ideal d.quotientFinite
+```
+
+## New
+
+```lean
+abbrev pbcAdicCompletion (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
+    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) :=
+  completedReductionCoefficient X d
+```

+/-! # Alternating rank-one resolutions -/
+@[expose] public noncomputable section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option synthInstance.maxSize 2048
+universe u v
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits ZeroObject
+namespace CochainComplex
+variable {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [HasZeroMorphisms A] [HasZeroObject A]
+
+private def alternatingD {M : A} (f g : End M) (i : ℤ) :
+    scalarPeriodicX M i ⟶ scalarPeriodicX M (i + 1) :=
+  if hi : i < 0 then
+    eqToHom (if_pos (le_of_lt hi)) ≫ (if i % 2 = 0 then f else g) ≫
+      eqToHom (if_pos (Int.add_one_le_iff.mpr hi)).symm
+  else 0
+
+private theorem alternatingD_comp {M : A} (f g : End M)
+    (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hgf : g ≫ f = 0) (i : ℤ) :
+    alternatingD f g i ≫ alternatingD f g (i + 1) = 0 := by
+  classical
+  by_cases hi : i < 0
+  · by_cases hj : i + 1 < 0

+    let e : P.sc' (i - 1) i (i + 1) ≅ (ShortComplex.mk g f hgf).map F :=

+        (F.mapIso (alternatingXIso f g hfg hgf (i - 1) (by omega)))

+    (F : B ⥤ D) [F.Additive] {M : B}
+    (f g : End M) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hgf : g ≫ f = 0)

+  by_cases hij : i + 1 = j
+  · subst j
+    simp only [alternating, CochainComplex.of_d, alternatingD]
+    split_ifs <;> simp only [Functor.map_comp, hf, hg, zero_comp, comp_zero, Functor.map_zero]

+    exact F.map_zero _ _

+    {B D : Type*} [Category* B] [Abelian B] [Category* D] [Abelian D]
+    (F : B ⥤ D) [F.Additive] {M : B}
+    (f g : End M) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hgf : g ≫ f = 0)

+  have h₂ : (P.sc i).g = 0 := alternating_map_d_zero F f g hfg hgf hf hg _ _

+    (f g : End (unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)))

+      (CochainComplex.alternatingAugmentation f g hfg hgf) := by
+  let P := CochainComplex.alternating f g hfg hgf
+  have hq : QuasiIso (CochainComplex.alternatingAugmentation f g hfg hgf) :=

+    let := monoidalCategory R
+    let := tensorPreadditive R
+    intro i
+    apply (exactFunctor _ _).prop_of_iso (siteSheafTensorRightIso R (P.X i)).symm
+    dsimp [P, CochainComplex.alternating, CochainComplex.scalarPeriodicX]
+    split_ifs
+    · exact (ObjectProperty.prop_unit ObjectProperty.flat).2
+    · have hz : IsZero (MonoidalCategory.tensorRight
+          (0 : SheafOfModules.{r}
+            ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R))) := by
+        rw [Functor.isZero_iff]
+        intro M
+        exact (MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft M).map_isZero (isZero_zero _)
+      have := Functor.preservesLimitsOfSize_of_isZero _ hz
+      have := Functor.preservesColimitsOfSize_of_isZero _ hz
+      change PreservesFiniteLimits _ ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits _
+      exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
+  have hb : P.IsStrictlyLE 0 := by
+    rw [CochainComplex.isStrictlyLE_iff]
+    intro i hi
+    simpa [P, CochainComplex.alternating, CochainComplex.scalarPeriodicX,
+      show ¬ i ≤ 0 by omega] using isZero_zero (SheafOfModules.{r}
+        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R))
+  have := hb
+  exact ⟨hq, isKFlatIndependentCoefficients_of_boundedAbove_flatOnSite R P 0 hflat⟩

+/-- A rank-one alternating exact complex has a K-flat augmentation, and annihilating
+both differentials makes its tensor cohomology equal to its rank-one terms.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 06YU, periodic free quotient resolutions; blueprint order
+1429, the counterexample's periodic-resolution calculation.
+(blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-alternating-unit-resolution).
+
+Proof: put the coefficient unit in each nonpositive degree and zero above, alternating
+f and g, with g entering degree zero. The two assumed exact short complexes prove
+exactness in every negative degree. The cokernel augmentation computes degree-zero
+homology and is therefore a quasi-isomorphism. All terms are flat and the complex is
+bounded above, so the augmentation is a K-flat resolution. After tensoring, if both
+endomorphisms vanish, every differential vanishes. The homology is then the term in
+that degree, which is the tensor of the coefficient unit with the supplied module.
+The statement includes degree zero and the zero module.
+-/
+theorem alternatingUnit_resolution
+    (f g : End (unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)))
+    (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hgf : g ≫ f = 0)
+    (hef : (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).Exact)
+    (heg : (ShortComplex.mk g f hgf).Exact) :
+    letI := isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
+    letI := monoidalCategory R
+    letI := tensorPreadditive R
+    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r}
+        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ)
+      (p : P ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (cokernel g)),
+      CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients p ∧
+      ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{r}
+          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R))
+        (i : ℤ), i ≤ 0 → (MonoidalCategory.tensorRight M).map f = 0 →
+        (MonoidalCategory.tensorRight M).map g = 0 →
+        Nonempty ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (.up ℤ) i).obj
+          (((MonoidalCategory.tensorRight M).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≅
+            (MonoidalCategory.tensorRight M).obj (unit _)) := by
+  let := isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
+  let := monoidalCategory R
+  let := tensorPreadditive R
+  refine ⟨CochainComplex.alternating f g hfg hgf,
+    CochainComplex.alternatingAugmentation f g hfg hgf,
+    alternating_unit_kFlat R f g hfg hgf hef heg, ?_⟩
+  intro M i hi hf hg
+  exact ⟨CochainComplex.alternating_map_homology_iso
+    (MonoidalCategory.tensorRight M) f g hfg hgf hf hg i hi⟩
+
+end SheafOfModules

+Source: Stacks Project, sites-modules.tex, Tag 093M; sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 06YU;

+Proof: the ordinary quotient A/(varpi^(n+1)) has the short exact free presentation
+A --varpi^(n+1)--> A --> A/(varpi^(n+1)). Exact constant sheafification and flatness
+of the completed coefficient algebra give the corresponding presentation over B.
+Exact inverse image along g preserves it. The regular-module inverse-image isomorphism
+and its coefficient-restriction version identify the first two terms with g⁻¹B and the
+third with g⁻¹R_n. Their section normalization and naturality of the ring adjunction unit
+identify the quotient map with the canonical coefficient map, which sends 1 to 1.
+The normalized two-term scalar-extension triangle therefore applies to Q(L). In degree
+q<a-1 its long exact cohomology sequence has zero outer terms H^q(L) and H^(q+1)(L).
+The middle cohomology is zero after exact scalar restriction. Restriction does not change
+the underlying abelian sheaf, so faithful forgetting reflects zero and gives the result.
+This includes zero complexes, the empty scheme, and the first positive quotient. -/
+theorem integralLocalReduction_isGE
+    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
+    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
+    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
+    (L : CochainComplex (pbcModules Y
+      ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj (pbcAdicCompletion X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)))) ℤ)
+    (a : ℤ) [L.IsStrictlyGE a] (n : ℕ) :
+    (adicTowerLocalReduction (pbcIntegralDatum l E) g L n).IsGE (a - 1) := by
+  let A := PbcIntegralRing l E
+  let e : A ≃+* Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E := ULift.ringEquiv
+  let : IsDomain A := e.toMulEquiv.isDomain _
+  have hπ : pbcUniformizer l E ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    exact AlgebraicGeometry.uniformizer_ne_zero l E (congrArg ULift.down h)
+  obtain ⟨p, hz, hs, hp⟩ := completed_principal_resolution X
+    (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (pbcUniformizer l E) rfl hπ n
+  obtain ⟨f', hz', hs'⟩ := normalized_pullback_sequence g
+    (pbcAdicProjection X (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n) _ p hp hz hs
+  exact lower_bound_of_coefficient_sequence Y _ f' _
+    (fun V ↦ by
+      change (((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
+        (pbcAdicProjection X (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n)).hom.app V)
+          (1 : ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj
+            (pbcAdicCompletion X (pbcIntegralDatum l E))).obj.obj V) = 1
+      exact map_one _) hz' hs' (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) a
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

+
+@[expose] public noncomputable section

+private def ordinaryIso : pbcExtend φ ≅ SheafOfModules.ordinaryExtension.{u + 1, u, u + 1}

+  have hobj (M : pbcModules T R) : F.obj M =

+        (J := ProEt.topology T) φ).obj M :=
+    (pbcExtensionExistence φ).choose_spec.choose M
+  refine NatIso.ofComponents (fun M ↦ eqToIso (hobj M)) ?_
+  intro M N f
+  have hm : F.map f = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫
+      SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom φ M f ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm :=
+    (pbcExtensionExistence φ).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose f
+  change F.map f ≫ eqToHom (hobj N) = _
+  rw [hm]
+  simp only [Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
+  rfl

+private def leftTensorIso

+    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R

+  let := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
+  let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+  refine NatIso.ofComponents (fun N ↦ SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification M N) ?_
+  intro N N' f
+  have h := SheafOfModules.whiskerLeft_tensorObjIsoSheafification_hom_kfi M f
+  let a := PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u + 1}
+    (𝟙 ((adicLisseForget T).obj R).obj)
+  have he : (SheafOfModules.leftTensorSheaf (B := R) M).map f =
+      a.map (M.val ◁ f.val) := by
+    change a.map (SheafOfModules.siteTensorSecondMap M.val f.val) = _
+    congr 1
+  rw [he]
+  exact h
+
+private def extensionTensorIso :
+    letI := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
+    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+    tensorLeft ((pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S))) ≅
+      pbcExtend φ ⋙ pbcRestrict φ := by
+  let : EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} T.ProEt := essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _
+  let := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
+  let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+  exact leftTensorIso T _ ≪≫ SheafOfModules.tensorExtensionIso (J := ProEt.topology T) φ ≪≫
+    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (ordinaryIso T φ).symm (pbcRestrict φ)
+
+private theorem scalar_resolution_homology
+    (P : CochainComplex (pbcModules T R) ℤ)
+    (r : P ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
+      ((pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S))))
+    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients r)

+    letI := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
+    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R

+    WeilConjectures.integralCoefficientAbLocallyBijective.{u, 0} T

+  let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+  let := SheafOfModules.tensorPreadditive R

+  obtain ⟨Q, s, hQ, _, hs, _⟩ :=
+    CochainComplex.exists_isKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients (R := R) sM
+  have : QuasiIso r := hP.1
+  have : QuasiIso s := hs
+  let F := curriedTensor (pbcModules T R)
+  let f := HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 P) s F (.up ℤ)
+  let g := HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap r (𝟙 Q) F (.up ℤ)
+  have : QuasiIso f := ResidueTensor.tensor_left_quasiIso R s hs hP.2
+  have : QuasiIso g := ResidueTensor.tensor_right_quasiIso R r hP.1 hQ

+  let e₂ := CochainComplex.mapBifunctorSingle₁Iso F
+    ((pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S))) Q
+  let e₃ := (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (extensionTensorIso T φ) (.up ℤ)).app Q
+  have : IsIso (pbcComplexCounit φ Q) := complexCounit_isIso T φ Q hQ
+  let e₄ := (pbcDerivedRestrict φ).mapIso (asIso (pbcComplexCounit φ Q)) ≪≫
+    (pbcRestrict φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.app
+      (((pbcExtend φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
+  let e₅ := DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso e₃
+  let e₆ := (pbcDerivedExtend φ).mapIso (asIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map s))
+  exact ⟨(HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (.up ℤ) i).mapIso e₁.symm ≪≫

+    asIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap g i) ≪≫
+    (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (.up ℤ) i).mapIso e₂ ≪≫
+    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors _ i).app _).symm ≪≫
+    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).mapIso
+      (e₅ ≪≫ e₄.symm ≪≫ (pbcDerivedRestrict φ).mapIso e₆) ≪≫
+    ((pbcRestrict φ).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso i).symm.app _⟩
+
+
+
+private local instance restriction_faithful
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
+    (φ : R ⟶ S) : (pbcRestrict φ).Faithful where
+  map_injective := by
+    intro M N f g h
+    ext U x
+    exact congrArg (fun k ↦ k.val.app U x) h
+
+private theorem full_restriction_of_unit_epi
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (φ : R ⟶ S)
+    (p : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
+      (pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S))) [Epi p]
+    (hp : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) = (1 : S.obj.obj U)) :
+    (pbcRestrict φ).Full := by
+  let F := SheafOfModules.toSheaf ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)
+  have : Epi (F.map p) := inferInstance
+  have hsurj : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (ProEt.topology T) (F.map p).hom :=
+    (Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' _ (F.map p)).2 inferInstance
+  have hform (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : R.obj.obj U) :
+      p.val.app U x = φ.hom.app U x := by
+    have h := (p.val.app U).hom.map_smul x (1 : R.obj.obj U)
+    change (p.val.app U (x * (1 : R.obj.obj U)) : S.obj.obj U) =
+      φ.hom.app U x * (@id (S.obj.obj U) (p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) at h
+    simpa only [mul_one, hp U, id_eq] using h
+  have : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (ProEt.topology T)
+      ((adicLisseForget T).map φ).hom := by

+    intro U s
+    apply (ProEt.topology T).superset_covering _ (Presheaf.imageSieve_mem _ (F.map p).hom s)

+private theorem tensor_scalar_zero
+    (f : End (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)))
+    (M : pbcModules T R)
+    (hkill : ∀ (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U),

+  let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+  let := SheafOfModules.tensorPreadditive R

+    ext U x
+    change (ReductionTensor.tensorMultiplication T R f M).val.app U x = 0

+    exact hkill U x

+      (J := ProEt.topology T) (A := R) M).map f = 0 := by
+    apply (cancel_epi e.inv).1
+    apply (cancel_mono e.hom).1

+    simpa only [Category.assoc, comp_zero, zero_comp] using hμ
+  let c := SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRightIso R M
+  apply (cancel_epi (c.hom.app _)).1
+  have h := c.hom.naturality f
+  rw [hsite, zero_comp] at h
+  simpa only [comp_zero] using h.symm

+/-- An exact alternating resolution of a quotient unit computes nonpositive Tor with
+any quotient module annihilated by both alternating scalars.
+
+Source: blueprint order 1429, residue counterexample in the levelwise-truncation
+proposition; Stacks Project, Tag 0118.
+(blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-periodic-quotient-tor).
+
+Proof: the exact alternating complex of units resolves the cokernel of the second
+scalar. The normalized quotient epimorphism identifies this cokernel with the
+restricted quotient unit. This bounded-above complex of flat modules is K-flat.
+After tensoring with the given module both differentials vanish, so every
+nonpositive cohomology is the module itself. To identify this calculation with the
+specified derived scalar extension, choose a K-flat resolution of the module and
+use the double tensor complex. Tensoring either augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism;
+the ordinary tensor-extension comparison and the universal derived-extension counit
+identify the other end with the prescribed derived reduction. Finally exact faithful
+full quotient restriction lifts the resulting cohomology isomorphism to the quotient.
+The computation includes degree zero and makes no boundedness assumption on Tor. -/
+theorem periodicQuotient_tor
+    (f g : End (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)))
+    (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hgf : g ≫ f = 0)
+    (hef : (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).Exact)
+    (heg : (ShortComplex.mk g f hgf).Exact)
+    (p : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
+      (pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S)))
+    [Epi p] (hp : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ,
+      p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) = (1 : S.obj.obj U))
+    (hz : g ≫ p = 0) (hex : (ShortComplex.mk g p hz).Exact)
+    (N : pbcModules T S)
+    (hfkill : ∀ (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : ((pbcRestrict φ).obj N).val.obj U),
+      f.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) • x = 0)
+    (hgkill : ∀ (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : ((pbcRestrict φ).obj N).val.obj U),
+      g.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) • x = 0)
+    (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ 0) :
+    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
+      ((pbcDerivedExtend φ).obj
+        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((pbcRestrict φ).obj N))) ≅ N) := by
+  let : EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} T.ProEt := essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _
+  let := SheafOfModules.isMonoidal_W_independentCoefficients R
+  let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+  let := SheafOfModules.tensorPreadditive R
+  let := full_restriction_of_unit_epi T φ p hp
+  let M := (pbcRestrict φ).obj N
+  let v := cokernel.desc g p hz
+  have : Mono v := hex.mono_cokernelDesc
+  have : Epi (cokernel.π g ≫ v) := by simpa only [v, cokernel.π_desc] using inferInstanceAs (Epi p)
+  have : Epi v := epi_of_epi (cokernel.π g) v
+  have : IsIso v := isIso_of_mono_of_epi v
+  obtain ⟨P,r,hP,hcoh⟩ := SheafOfModules.alternatingUnit_resolution R f g hfg hgf hef heg
+  let r' := r ≫ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map v
+  have : QuasiIso r := hP.1
+  have : QuasiIso r' := inferInstanceAs (QuasiIso (r ≫ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map v))
+  obtain ⟨eh⟩ := scalar_resolution_homology T φ P r' ⟨inferInstance,hP.2⟩ M i
+  obtain ⟨ez⟩ := hcoh M i hi (tensor_scalar_zero T f M hfkill) (tensor_scalar_zero T g M hgkill)
+  exact ⟨(pbcRestrict φ).preimageIso (eh.symm ≪≫ ez ≪≫ MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor M)⟩
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

+private theorem power_comp
+    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C] {M N : C}
+    (f : End M) (t : End N) (p : M ⟶ N) (h : f ≫ p = p ≫ t) (n : ℕ) :
+    (f ^ n) ≫ p = p ≫ (t ^ n) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp
+  | succ n ih =>
+    simp only [pow_succ, End.mul_def, Category.assoc]
+    rw [ih, ← Category.assoc, h, Category.assoc]
+
+private theorem exact_powers_on_monic_quotient
+    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C] {M N : C}
+    (f : End M) [Mono f] (t : End N) (p : M ⟶ N) [Epi p]
+    (a b : ℕ) (hp : (f ^ (a + b)) ≫ p = 0)
+    (hep : (ShortComplex.mk (f ^ (a + b)) p hp).Exact)
+    (hpt : f ≫ p = p ≫ t) :
+    ∃ h : (t ^ a) ≫ (t ^ b) = 0, (ShortComplex.mk (t ^ a) (t ^ b) h).Exact := by
+  have hzero : (t ^ a) ≫ (t ^ b) = 0 := by
+    apply (cancel_epi p).1
+    rw [comp_zero, ← Category.assoc, ← power_comp f t p hpt a,
+      Category.assoc, ← power_comp f t p hpt b, ← Category.assoc]
+    simpa only [← End.mul_def, ← pow_add, Nat.add_comm b a] using hp
+  refine ⟨hzero, (ShortComplex.exact_iff_exact_up_to_refinements _).2 ?_⟩
+  intro Q x hx
+  obtain ⟨Q', e, he, y, hy⟩ := surjective_up_to_refinements_of_epi p x
+  have : Epi e := he
+  have hyt : (y ≫ (f ^ b)) ≫ p = 0 := by
+    rw [Category.assoc, power_comp f t p hpt b, ← Category.assoc, ← hy,
+      Category.assoc, hx, comp_zero]
+  obtain ⟨Q'', e', he', z, hz⟩ := hep.exact_up_to_refinements (y ≫ (f ^ b)) hyt
+  have : Epi e' := he'
+  have hmono (n : ℕ) : Mono (f ^ n) := by
+    induction n with
+    | zero => change Mono (𝟙 M); infer_instance
+    | succ n ih =>
+      rw [pow_succ]
+      change Mono (f ≫ (f ^ n))
+      infer_instance
+  have : Mono (f ^ b) := hmono b
+  have hcancel : e' ≫ y = z ≫ (f ^ a) := by
+    apply (cancel_mono (f ^ b)).1
+    have hpow : f ^ (a + b) = (f ^ a) ≫ (f ^ b) := by
+      rw [Nat.add_comm a b, pow_add, End.mul_def]
+    simpa only [hpow, Category.assoc] using hz
+  refine ⟨Q'', e' ≫ e, inferInstance, z ≫ p, ?_⟩
+  rw [Category.assoc, hy, ← Category.assoc, hcancel]
+  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, power_comp f t p hpt a]
+
+private theorem exact_quotient_descend
+    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C] {M N P : C}
+    (f : End M) (t : End N) (p : M ⟶ N) [Epi p]
+    (r : M ⟶ P) (s : N ⟶ P) (hps : p ≫ s = r)
+    (hp : f ≫ r = 0) (hex : (ShortComplex.mk f r hp).Exact)
+    (hpt : f ≫ p = p ≫ t) :
+    ∃ h : t ≫ s = 0, (ShortComplex.mk t s h).Exact := by
+  have hz : t ≫ s = 0 := by
+    apply (cancel_epi p).1
+    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hpt, Category.assoc, hps, hp, comp_zero]
+  refine ⟨hz, (ShortComplex.exact_iff_exact_up_to_refinements _).2 ?_⟩
+  intro Q x hx
+  obtain ⟨Q',e,he,y,hy⟩ := surjective_up_to_refinements_of_epi p x
+  have : Epi e := he
+  have hyr : y ≫ r = 0 := by
+    rw [← hps, ← Category.assoc, ← hy, Category.assoc, hx, comp_zero]
+  obtain ⟨Q'',e',he',z,hz'⟩ := hex.exact_up_to_refinements y hyr
+  have : Epi e' := he'
+  refine ⟨Q'',e' ≫ e,inferInstance,z ≫ p,?_⟩
+  rw [Category.assoc, hy, ← Category.assoc, hz', Category.assoc, hpt]
+  exact (Category.assoc z p t).symm
+

+private local instance restriction_faithful
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
+    (φ : R ⟶ S) : (pbcRestrict φ).Faithful where
+  map_injective := by
+    intro M N f g h
+    ext U x
+    exact congrArg (fun k ↦ k.val.app U x) h

+private theorem full_restriction_of_unit_epi
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (φ : R ⟶ S)
+    (p : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
+      (pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S))) [Epi p]
+    (hp : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) = (1 : S.obj.obj U)) :
+    (pbcRestrict φ).Full := by
+  let F := SheafOfModules.toSheaf ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)
+  have : Epi (F.map p) := inferInstance
+  have hsurj : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (ProEt.topology T) (F.map p).hom :=
+    (Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' _ (F.map p)).2 inferInstance
+  have hform (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : R.obj.obj U) :
+      p.val.app U x = φ.hom.app U x := by
+    have h := (p.val.app U).hom.map_smul x (1 : R.obj.obj U)
+    change (p.val.app U (x * (1 : R.obj.obj U)) : S.obj.obj U) =
+      φ.hom.app U x * (@id (S.obj.obj U) (p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) at h
+    simpa only [mul_one, hp U, id_eq] using h
+  have : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (ProEt.topology T)
+      ((adicLisseForget T).map φ).hom := by
+    constructor
+    intro U s
+    apply (ProEt.topology T).superset_covering _ (Presheaf.imageSieve_mem _ (F.map p).hom s)
+    intro V f hf
+    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf
+    exact ⟨x, (hform (op V) x).symm.trans hx⟩
+  exact SheafOfModules.restriction_full ((adicLisseForget T).map φ)
+

+private theorem scalar_unit_action
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
+    (f : End (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))) :
+    (ReductionTensor.multiplicationNatural T R f).app
+      (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)) = f := by
+  ext U
+  change (ReductionTensor.tensorMultiplication T R f
+    (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))).val.app U
+      (1 : R.obj.obj U) = f.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U)
+  rw [ReductionTensor.tensorMultiplication_apply]
+  change (@id (R.obj.obj U) (f.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) * (1 : R.obj.obj U) = _
+  exact mul_one _
+

+private theorem quotient_periodic_data
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {B R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
+    (φ : B ⟶ R) (ψ : R ⟶ S) (χ : B ⟶ S) (hcomp : φ ≫ ψ = χ)
+    (f : End (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj B))) [Mono f]
+    (a b : ℕ)
+    (p : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj B) ⟶
+      (pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)))
+    (r : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj B) ⟶
+      (pbcRestrict χ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S)))
+    (hp : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, p.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U) = (1 : R.obj.obj U))
+    (hr : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, r.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U) = (1 : S.obj.obj U))
+    (hzp : (f ^ (a + b)) ≫ p = 0)
+    (hsp : (ShortComplex.mk (f ^ (a + b)) p hzp).ShortExact)
+    (hzr : (f ^ a) ≫ r = 0)
+    (hsr : (ShortComplex.mk (f ^ a) r hzr).ShortExact) :
+    ∃ t : End (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)),
+      (∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, t.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) =
+        φ.hom.app U (f.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U))) ∧
+      ∃ (hz₁ : (t ^ b) ≫ (t ^ a) = 0) (hz₂ : (t ^ a) ≫ (t ^ b) = 0),
+        (ShortComplex.mk (t ^ b) (t ^ a) hz₁).Exact ∧
+        (ShortComplex.mk (t ^ a) (t ^ b) hz₂).Exact ∧
+        ∃ hz : (t ^ a) ≫ coefficientUnitMap T ψ = 0,
+          (ShortComplex.mk (t ^ a) (coefficientUnitMap T ψ) hz).Exact ∧
+          Epi (coefficientUnitMap T ψ) := by
+  let F := pbcRestrict φ
+  have : Epi p := hsp.epi_g
+  have : Epi r := hsr.epi_g
+  let := full_restriction_of_unit_epi T φ p hp
+  let α := ReductionTensor.multiplicationNatural T B f
+  let t : End (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)) :=
+    F.preimage (α.app (F.obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))))
+  have ht : F.map t = α.app (F.obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))) :=
+    F.map_preimage _
+  have hpt : f ≫ p = p ≫ F.map t := by
+    have hu : α.app (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj B)) = f :=
+      scalar_unit_action T B f
+    have hn : p ≫ α.app (F.obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))) =
+        α.app (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj B)) ≫ p := α.naturality p
+    exact (congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ p) hu).symm.trans
+      (hn.symm.trans (congrArg (fun k ↦ p ≫ k) ht.symm))
+  let tB : End (F.obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))) := F.map t
+  have hmap (k : ℕ) : F.map (t ^ k) = tB ^ k :=
+    map_pow (F.mapEnd (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))) t k
+  obtain ⟨h₁,he₁⟩ := exact_powers_on_monic_quotient f tB p b a
+    (by simpa only [Nat.add_comm b a] using hzp)
+    (by simpa only [Nat.add_comm b a] using hsp.exact) hpt
+  obtain ⟨h₂,he₂⟩ := exact_powers_on_monic_quotient f tB p a b hzp hsp.exact hpt
+  have hz₁ : (t ^ b) ≫ (t ^ a) = 0 := F.map_injective (by
+    simpa only [Functor.map_comp, hmap, Functor.map_zero] using h₁)
+  have hz₂ : (t ^ a) ≫ (t ^ b) = 0 := F.map_injective (by
+    simpa only [Functor.map_comp, hmap, Functor.map_zero] using h₂)
+  have he₁' : (ShortComplex.mk (t ^ b) (t ^ a) hz₁).Exact :=
+    ((ShortComplex.mk (t ^ b) (t ^ a) hz₁).exact_map_iff_of_faithful F).1 (by
+      simpa only [ShortComplex.map, hmap] using he₁)
+  have he₂' : (ShortComplex.mk (t ^ a) (t ^ b) hz₂).Exact :=
+    ((ShortComplex.mk (t ^ a) (t ^ b) hz₂).exact_map_iff_of_faithful F).1 (by
+      simpa only [ShortComplex.map, hmap] using he₂)
+  refine ⟨t, ?_, hz₁, hz₂, he₁', he₂', ?_⟩
+  · intro U
+    have hh := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U)) ht
+    change t.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) =
+      (ReductionTensor.tensorMultiplication T B f
+        (F.obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)))).val.app U
+          (1 : R.obj.obj U) at hh
+    rw [ReductionTensor.tensorMultiplication_apply] at hh
+    change t.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) =
+      φ.hom.app U (f.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U)) * (1 : R.obj.obj U) at hh
+    simpa only [mul_one] using hh
+  · let s := coefficientUnitMap T ψ
+    let e := (pbcRestrictComp φ ψ χ hcomp).app
+      (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S))
+    have hps : p ≫ F.map s = r ≫ e.inv := by
+      apply (cancel_mono e.hom).1
+      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
+      ext U
+      change e.hom.val.app U (ψ.hom.app U (p.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U))) =
+        r.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U)
+      erw [(pbcRestrictComp_exists φ ψ χ hcomp).exists.choose_spec]
+      rw [hp, hr, map_one]
+    have hzr' : (f ^ a) ≫ (r ≫ e.inv) = 0 := by rw [← Category.assoc,hzr,zero_comp]
+    have her' : (ShortComplex.mk (f ^ a) (r ≫ e.inv) hzr').Exact :=
+      by
+        let s₁ := ShortComplex.mk (f ^ a) r hzr
+        let s₂ := ShortComplex.mk (f ^ a) (r ≫ e.inv) hzr'
+        let ei : s₁ ≅ s₂ := ShortComplex.isoMk (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) e.symm
+          (by simp only [s₁,s₂,Iso.refl_hom,Category.comp_id,Category.id_comp])
+          (by simp only [s₁,s₂,Iso.refl_hom,Category.id_comp,Iso.symm_hom])
+        exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso ei).mp hsr.exact
+    obtain ⟨hz,hex⟩ := exact_quotient_descend (f ^ a) (tB ^ a) p
+      (r ≫ e.inv) (F.map s) hps hzr' her' (power_comp f tB p hpt a)
+    have hzs : (t ^ a) ≫ s = 0 := F.map_injective (by
+      simpa only [Functor.map_comp,hmap,Functor.map_zero] using hz)
+    have hes : (ShortComplex.mk (t ^ a) s hzs).Exact :=
+      ((ShortComplex.mk (t ^ a) s hzs).exact_map_iff_of_faithful F).1 (by
+        simpa only [ShortComplex.map,hmap] using hex)
+    have : Epi (r ≫ e.inv) := inferInstance
+    have : Epi (p ≫ F.map s) := by rw [hps]; infer_instance
+    have : Epi (F.map s) := epi_of_epi p (F.map s)
+    have : Epi s := F.epi_of_epi_map inferInstance
+    exact ⟨hzs,hes,inferInstance⟩
+

+private theorem normalized_unit_apply
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
+    (φ : R ⟶ S)
+    (p : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
+      (pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S)))
+    (hp : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) = (1 : S.obj.obj U))
+    (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : R.obj.obj U) : p.val.app U x = φ.hom.app U x := by
+  have h := (p.val.app U).hom.map_smul x (1 : R.obj.obj U)
+  change (p.val.app U (x * (1 : R.obj.obj U)) : S.obj.obj U) =
+    φ.hom.app U x * (@id (S.obj.obj U) (p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) at h
+  simpa only [mul_one,hp U,id_eq] using h

+private theorem unit_end_pow_one
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
+    (t : End (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)))
+    (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (k : ℕ) :
+    (t ^ k).val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) =
+      (@id (R.obj.obj U) (t.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) ^ k := by
+  induction k with
+  | zero => simp only [pow_zero,End.one_def]; rfl
+  | succ k ih =>
+    rw [pow_succ,End.mul_def]
+    change (t ^ k).val.app U (t.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U)) = _
+    have h := ((t ^ k).val.app U).hom.map_smul
+      (@id (R.obj.obj U) (t.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) (1 : R.obj.obj U)
+    change (@id (R.obj.obj U) ((t ^ k).val.app U
+      ((@id (R.obj.obj U) (t.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) * (1 : R.obj.obj U)))) =
+      (@id (R.obj.obj U) (t.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) *
+        (@id (R.obj.obj U) ((t ^ k).val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) at h
+    simpa only [mul_one,one_mul,ih,pow_succ,mul_comm,id_eq] using h

+/-- Every nonpositive cohomology of adjacent principal-quotient reduction of the
+residue single module is the residue module at the lower level.
+
+Source: blueprint order 1429, counterexample in (1) of the levelwise-truncation
+proposition; Stacks Project, Tags 06YU and 0118.
+(blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-principal-adjacent-quotient-tor).
+
+Proof: completion preserves each principal quotient sequence. The scalar on the
+completed unit descends to an endomorphism t of the next quotient unit, since quotient
+restriction is full. Epimorphism refinements and cancellation of the monic completed
+scalar show that t and t^(n + 1) form an exact alternating pair. The lower quotient is
+the cokernel of the latter map. Its normalized quotient map determines the augmentation.
+Both alternating scalars vanish on the residue module: the first completed principal
+sequence kills the original scalar on the residue, and quotient-map composition carries
+this equality to the next level. Positive powers also vanish. Apply the periodic unit
+resolution computation, then transport along the canonical composition of restrictions.
+This computes all nonpositive degrees without a flatness assumption on the residue. -/
+theorem principalAdjacentQuotient_tor
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
+    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (π : A) (hI : d.ideal = Ideal.span {π})
+    (hπ : π ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ 0) :
+    let H := SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op 0)))
+    let M := (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicQuotient T d (n + 1) 0 (Nat.zero_le _))).obj H
+    let N := (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicQuotient T d n 0 (Nat.zero_le _))).obj H
+    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
+      ((pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n))).obj
+        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)) ≅ N) := by
+  let B := pbcAdicCompletion T d
+  let R := (pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op (n + 1))
+  let S := (pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n)
+  let R0 := (pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op 0)
+  let H := SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R0)
+  let φ := pbcAdicProjection T d (n + 1)
+  let ψ := pbcAdicQuotient T d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)
+  let χ := pbcAdicProjection T d n
+  let ρ := pbcAdicQuotient T d (n + 1) 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
+  let σ := pbcAdicQuotient T d n 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
+  let c := CompletedConstantReduction.base T d.ideal ≫
+    CompletedConstantReduction.completedComparison T d.ideal d.quotientFinite
+  let F := adicLisseConstantModules T A ⋙ completedAdicChange T c
+  let e := CompletedConstantReduction.constantChange_unit T c
+  let μ : A →* End (ModuleCat.of A A) := {
+    toFun a := ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulLeft A a)
+    map_one' := by apply End.ext; ext; simp
+    map_mul' := by intro a b; apply End.ext; ext; simp [End.mul_def] }
+  let f : End (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj B)) :=
+    e.conj (F.map (μ π))
+  have hpow (k : ℕ) : f ^ k = e.inv ≫
+      F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulLeft A (π ^ k))) ≫ e.hom := by
+    change (e.conj ((F.mapEnd (ModuleCat.of A A)) (μ π))) ^ k =
+      e.conj ((F.mapEnd (ModuleCat.of A A)) (μ (π ^ k)))
+    rw [map_pow,map_pow,map_pow]
+  obtain ⟨p,hzp,hsp,hp⟩ := completed_principal_resolution T d π hI hπ (n + 1)
+  obtain ⟨r,hzr,hsr,hr⟩ := completed_principal_resolution T d π hI hπ n
+  obtain ⟨p0,hz0,hs0,hp0⟩ := completed_principal_resolution T d π hI hπ 0
+  have hf0 : e.inv ≫ F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulLeft A (π ^ (0 + 1)))) ≫
+      e.hom = f := by simpa only [Nat.zero_add,pow_one] using (hpow 1).symm
+  have : Mono f := by rw [← hf0]; exact hs0.mono_f
+  have hz0f : f ≫ p0 = 0 := by rw [← hf0]; exact hz0
+  have hzpf : (f ^ (n + 1 + 1)) ≫ p = 0 := by rw [hpow]; exact hzp
+  have hspf : (ShortComplex.mk (f ^ (n + 1 + 1)) p hzpf).ShortExact := by
+    simpa only [hpow] using hsp
+  have hzrf : (f ^ (n + 1)) ≫ r = 0 := by rw [hpow]; exact hzr
+  have hsrf : (ShortComplex.mk (f ^ (n + 1)) r hzrf).ShortExact := by
+    simpa only [hpow] using hsr
+  obtain ⟨t,ht,hfg,hgf,hef,heg,hz,hex,hepi⟩ := quotient_periodic_data T φ ψ χ
+    (pbcAdicProjection_comp T d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)) f (n + 1) 1
+      p r hp hr hzpf hspf hzrf hsrf
+  have := hepi
+  have hzero (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) :
+      (pbcAdicProjection T d 0).hom.app U (f.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U)) = 0 := by
+    have h := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U)) hz0f
+    change p0.val.app U (f.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U)) = 0 at h
+    rw [normalized_unit_apply T _ p0 hp0] at h
+    exact h
+  have htzero (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) : ρ.hom.app U (t.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U)) = 0 := by
+    rw [ht]
+    have hc := pbcAdicProjection_comp T d (n + 1) 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
+    have hh := congrArg (fun k : B ⟶ R0 ↦
+      k.hom.app U (f.val.app U (1 : B.obj.obj U))) hc

+  have hkill (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
+      (x : ((pbcRestrict ψ).obj N).val.obj U) :
+      (@id (R.obj.obj U) ((t ^ k).val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) • x = 0 := by
+    change σ.hom.app U (ψ.hom.app U ((t ^ k).val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) *
+      (@id (R0.obj.obj U) x) = 0

+    have hh := congrArg (fun f : R ⟶ R0 ↦
+      f.hom.app U ((t ^ k).val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) hc
+    change σ.hom.app U (ψ.hom.app U _) = ρ.hom.app U _ at hh
+    rw [hh,unit_end_pow_one,map_pow]

+    erw [htzero]
+    rw [zero_pow (by omega),zero_mul]

+      change ψ.hom.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) = 1
+      exact map_one _) hz hex N
+      (hkill 1 (by omega)) (hkill (n + 1) (by omega)) i hi
+  let eN := (pbcRestrictComp ψ σ ρ
+    (pbcAdicQuotient_comp T d (n + 1) n 0 (Nat.zero_le _) (Nat.le_succ n))).app H

+    ((pbcDerivedExtend ψ).mapIso ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso eN.symm)) ≪≫ et⟩

+/-! # Self-reduction along a regular quotient of coefficient sheaves -/
+
+@[expose] public noncomputable section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option synthInstance.maxSize 2048
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+universe u
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

+
+private local instance restriction_faithful
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
+    (φ : R ⟶ S) : (pbcRestrict φ).Faithful where
+  map_injective := by
+    intro M N f g h
+    ext U x
+    exact congrArg (fun k ↦ k.val.app U x) h
+
+private theorem full_restriction_of_unit_epi
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (φ : R ⟶ S)
+    (p : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
+      (pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S))) [Epi p]
+    (hp : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) = (1 : S.obj.obj U)) :
+    (pbcRestrict φ).Full := by
+  let F := SheafOfModules.toSheaf ((adicLisseForget T).obj R)
+  have : Epi (F.map p) := inferInstance
+  have hsurj : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (ProEt.topology T) (F.map p).hom :=
+    (Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' _ (F.map p)).2 inferInstance
+  have hform (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : R.obj.obj U) :
+      p.val.app U x = φ.hom.app U x := by
+    have h := (p.val.app U).hom.map_smul x (1 : R.obj.obj U)
+    change (p.val.app U (x * (1 : R.obj.obj U)) : S.obj.obj U) =
+      φ.hom.app U x * (@id (S.obj.obj U) (p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) at h
+    simpa only [mul_one, hp U, id_eq] using h
+  have : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (ProEt.topology T)
+      ((adicLisseForget T).map φ).hom := by
+    constructor
+    intro U s
+    apply (ProEt.topology T).superset_covering _ (Presheaf.imageSieve_mem _ (F.map p).hom s)
+    intro V f hf
+    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf
+    exact ⟨x, (hform (op V) x).symm.trans hx⟩
+  exact SheafOfModules.restriction_full ((adicLisseForget T).map φ)
+
+
+
+/-- Derived reduction of a module already over a regular principal quotient has that
+module as its cohomology in degrees zero and minus one, and vanishes elsewhere.
+
+Source: blueprint order 1429, counterexample in the levelwise-truncation proposition;
+Stacks Project, Tag 06YU.
+(blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-regular-quotient-self-cohomology).
+
+Proof: the normalized unit quotient sequence gives a distinguished tensor triangle.
+Its first map acts by the generator, which is zero on every quotient module. The
+single complex has cohomology only in degree zero. The long exact sequence therefore
+identifies degree zero through the unit and degree minus one through the boundary,
+and forces all other degrees to vanish. Restriction along the quotient is exact,
+faithful and full: the normalized epimorphism of units makes the coefficient map
+locally surjective, so every linear map of restricted modules is quotient-linear.
+Thus the two cohomology identifications lift to the quotient coefficient category.
+No splitting of the derived object as a quotient-linear complex is asserted. -/
+theorem regularQuotient_single_cohomology
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
+    (φ : R ⟶ S)
+    (f : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
+      SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R))
+    (p : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⟶
+      (pbcRestrict φ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S)))
+    (hp : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U) = (1 : S.obj.obj U))
+    (hz : f ≫ p = 0) (hs : (ShortComplex.mk f p hz).ShortExact)
+    (N : pbcModules T S) :
+    let K := (pbcDerivedExtend φ).obj
+      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((pbcRestrict φ).obj N))
+    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 0).obj K ≅ N) ∧
+    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (-1)).obj K ≅ N) ∧
+    ∀ q : ℤ, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ -1 → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K) := by
+  have : Epi p := hs.epi_g
+  let := full_restriction_of_unit_epi T φ p hp
+  let M := (pbcRestrict φ).obj N
+  let L := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M
+  let K := (pbcDerivedExtend φ).obj L
+  let e₀ := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso _ 0).app M
+  have hform (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : R.obj.obj U) :
+      p.val.app U x = φ.hom.app U x := by
+    have h := (p.val.app U).hom.map_smul x (1 : R.obj.obj U)
+    change (p.val.app U (x * (1 : R.obj.obj U)) : S.obj.obj U) =
+      φ.hom.app U x * (@id (S.obj.obj U) (p.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U))) at h
+    simpa only [mul_one, hp U, id_eq] using h
+  have hscalar (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) :
+      φ.hom.app U (f.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U)) = 0 := by
+    have h := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U)) hz
+    change p.val.app U (f.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U)) = 0 at h
+    rw [hform] at h
+    exact h
+  let α := ReductionTensor.multiplicationNatural T R f
+  have hμ : α.app M = 0 := by
+    ext U x
+    change (ReductionTensor.tensorMultiplication T R f M).val.app U x = 0
+    rw [ReductionTensor.tensorMultiplication_apply]
+    change φ.hom.app U (f.val.app U (1 : R.obj.obj U)) •
+      (@id (N.val.obj U) x) = 0
+    rw [hscalar, zero_smul]
+  have hα (q : ℤ) : α.app ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj L) = 0 := by
+    by_cases hq : q = 0
+    · subst q
+      apply (cancel_mono e₀.hom).1
+      have h := α.naturality e₀.hom
+      change e₀.hom ≫ α.app M =
+        α.app ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 0).obj L) ≫ e₀.hom at h
+      rw [hμ, comp_zero] at h
+      simpa only [zero_comp] using h.symm
+    · have hzero : IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj L) := by
+        by_cases h : q < 0
+        · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE L 0 q h
+        · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isLE L 0 q (by omega)
+      exact hzero.eq_of_src _ _
+  obtain ⟨a,w,ht,hcoh⟩ := pbc_adic_reduction_triangle T φ f p hp hz hs L
+  let tr := Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk a ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φ).unit.app L) w
+  have ha (q : ℤ) : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map a = 0 := by
+    let H := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj L
+    let eH := ReductionTensor.tensorUnitIso T R H
+    have hF : (SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorRight
+        (J := ProEt.topology T) (A := R) H).map f = 0 := by
+      apply (cancel_epi eH.inv).1
+      apply (cancel_mono eH.hom).1
+      have hh := hα q
+      change eH.inv ≫ _ ≫ eH.hom = 0 at hh
+      simpa only [Category.assoc, comp_zero, zero_comp] using hh
+    obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := (hcoh q).1
+    apply (cancel_mono e.hom).1
+    dsimp only [H] at hF
+    rw [hF, comp_zero] at he
+    simpa only [zero_comp] using he
+  have hL (q : ℤ) (hq : q ≠ 0) : IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj L) := by
+    by_cases h : q < 0
+    · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE L 0 q h
+    · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isLE L 0 q (by omega)
+  have : Mono ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 0).map tr.mor₂) :=
+    (DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.mono_homologyMap_mor₂_iff tr ht 0).2 (ha 0)
+  have : Epi ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 0).map tr.mor₂) :=
+    (DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.epi_homologyMap_mor₂_iff tr ht 0 1 rfl).2
+      ((hL 1 (by omega)).eq_of_tgt _ _)
+  have : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 0).map tr.mor₂) :=
+    isIso_of_mono_of_epi _
+  let δ := DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.δ tr (-1) 0 (by omega)
+  have : Mono δ := (DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.exact₃ tr ht (-1) 0 (by omega)).mono_g
+    ((hL (-1) (by omega)).eq_of_src _ _)
+  have : Epi δ := (DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.exact₁ tr ht (-1) 0 (by omega)).epi_f
+    (ha 0)
+  have : IsIso δ := isIso_of_mono_of_epi _
+  let c₀ := ((pbcRestrict φ).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso 0).app K
+  let cm := ((pbcRestrict φ).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso (-1)).app K
+  refine ⟨⟨(pbcRestrict φ).preimageIso
+      (c₀ ≪≫ (asIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 0).map tr.mor₂)).symm ≪≫ e₀)⟩,
+    ⟨(pbcRestrict φ).preimageIso (cm ≪≫ asIso δ ≪≫ e₀)⟩, ?_⟩
+  intro q hq hq'
+  have hex := DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.exact₃ tr ht q (q+1) rfl
+  have hzero := hex.isZero_of_both_isZero (hL q hq) (hL (q+1) (by omega))
+  have hU : IsZero ((pbcRestrict φ).obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) :=
+    hzero.of_iso (((pbcRestrict φ).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso q).app K)
+  apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).2
+  apply (pbcRestrict φ).map_injective
+  simpa only [Functor.map_id, Functor.map_zero] using
+    hU.eq_of_src ((pbcRestrict φ).map (𝟙 _)) ((pbcRestrict φ).map (0 : _ ⟶ _))
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

+/-! # Completed reduction of a module with injective principal scalar -/
+@[expose] public noncomputable section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option synthInstance.maxSize 2048
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+universe u
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
+
+private theorem zero_module_sections_subsingleton
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
+    (M : pbcModules T R) (hM : IsZero M) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) :
+    Subsingleton (M.val.obj U) := by
+  let F := SheafOfModules.forget ((adicLisseForget T).obj R) ⋙
+    PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ U
+  have h := F.map_isZero hM
+  exact ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp h
+
+/-- Reduction of a degree-zero module with injective principal scalar is still
+concentrated in degree zero, without a flatness or finiteness hypothesis.
+
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 06YU; the principal quotient argument in the sufficient
+condition of the levelwise-truncation proposition.
+(blueprint: lem-weil-pbc-regular-single-reduction).
+
+Proof: the cohomology of the single object is the supplied module in degree zero and
+zero in every other degree. Thus the principal scalar is injective on all of its
+cohomology sheaves, by transport through the degree-zero homology isomorphism and by
+subsingleton sections in the other degrees. The normalized quotient triangle identifies
+every reduced cohomology sheaf with ordinary scalar extension of the corresponding
+original cohomology sheaf. In nonzero degrees its source is zero, and scalar extension
+preserves zero objects. This proves the stated vanishing in every nonzero degree.
+-/
+theorem principalReduction_single_isConcentrated
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
+    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (π : A) (hI : d.ideal = Ideal.span {π})
+    (hπ : π ≠ 0) (H : pbcModules T (pbcAdicCompletion T d))
+    (hinj : ∀ U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ, Function.Injective (fun x : H.val.obj U ↦
+      (CompletedConstantReduction.base T d.ideal ≫
+        CompletedConstantReduction.completedComparison T d.ideal d.quotientFinite).hom.app U
+          ((adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U π) • x)) (n : ℕ) :
+    ∀ q : ℤ, q ≠ 0 → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
+      ((pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicProjection T d n)).obj
+        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj H))) := by
+  let L := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj H
+  let c := CompletedConstantReduction.base T d.ideal ≫
+    CompletedConstantReduction.completedComparison T d.ideal d.quotientFinite
+  have hinjL (q : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) :
+      Function.Injective (fun x : ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj L).val.obj U ↦
+        c.hom.app U ((adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U π) • x) := by
+    by_cases hq : q = 0
+    · subst q
+      let e := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso _ 0).app H
+      intro x y hxy
+      have h : e.hom.val.app U x = e.hom.val.app U y := by
+        apply hinj U
+        have hh := congrArg (e.hom.val.app U) hxy
+        change (e.hom.val.app U).hom
+          (c.hom.app U ((adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U π) • x) =
+          (e.hom.val.app U).hom
+          (c.hom.app U ((adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U π) • y) at hh
+        rw [(e.hom.val.app U).hom.map_smul, (e.hom.val.app U).hom.map_smul] at hh
+        exact hh
+      have hc := congrArg (e.inv.val.app U) h
+      simpa only [← ModuleCat.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app,
+        ← SheafOfModules.comp_val, Iso.hom_inv_id, SheafOfModules.id_val,
+        PresheafOfModules.id_app, ModuleCat.id_apply] using hc
+    · have hz : IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj L) := by
+        by_cases h : q < 0
+        · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE L 0 q h
+        · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isLE L 0 q (by omega)
+      have := zero_module_sections_subsingleton T _ hz U
+      exact fun _ _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _
+  intro q hq
+  let φ := pbcAdicProjection T d n
+  let v := ((pbcScalarAdjunction φ).homEquiv _ _).symm
+    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map
+        ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φ).unit.app L) ≫
+      ((pbcRestrict φ).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso q).inv.app
+        ((pbcDerivedExtend φ).obj L))
+  have : IsIso v := principalReductionCohomology_isIso T d π hI hπ n L q (hinjL (q + 1))
+  have hz : IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj L) := by
+    by_cases h : q < 0
+    · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE L 0 q h
+    · exact DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isLE L 0 q (by omega)
+  exact ((pbcExtend φ).map_isZero hz).of_iso (asIso v).symm
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

+module

+/-! # Cohomology reduction under an injective principal scalar -/
+@[expose] public noncomputable section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option synthInstance.maxSize 2048
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+universe u
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
+
+private theorem constant_change_scalar_one
+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
+    {S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}}
+    (c : adicLisseConstantRing T A ⟶ S) (a : A) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) :
+    let F := adicLisseConstantModules T A ⋙ completedAdicChange T c
+    let e := CompletedConstantReduction.constantChange_unit T c
+    (e.inv ≫ F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulLeft A a)) ≫ e.hom).val.app U
+        (1 : S.obj.obj U) =
+      c.hom.app U ((adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U a) := by
+  let M := (adicLisseConstantModules T A).obj (ModuleCat.of A A)
+  let e := CompletedConstantReduction.constantChange_unit T c
+  let z := constantGenerator T (ModuleCat.of A A) U (1 : A)
+  let η := (pbcScalarAdjunction c).unit.app M
+  have hz : e.inv.val.app U (1 : S.obj.obj U) = η.val.app U z := by
+    rw [constant_unit_inv_one]
+    exact ((pbcScalarAdjunction_exists c).exists.choose_spec M U z).symm
+  have ha : constantGenerator T (ModuleCat.of A A) U a =
+      (adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U a • z := by
+    have h := ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
+      (adicLisseConstantUnit T A)).unit.app
+        ((constantPresheaves T A).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))).app U |>.hom.map_smul a (1 : A)
+    change constantGenerator T (ModuleCat.of A A) U (a * 1) =
+      (adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U a • z at h
+    simpa only [mul_one] using h
+  have hη : (@id (((completedAdicChange T c).obj M).val.obj U)
+        (η.val.app U (constantGenerator T (ModuleCat.of A A) U a))) =
+      c.hom.app U ((adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U a) •
+        (@id (((completedAdicChange T c).obj M).val.obj U) (η.val.app U z)) := by
+    rw [ha]
+    exact (η.val.app U).hom.map_smul _ _
+  have hunit (x : M.val.obj U) : η.val.app U x =
+      completedAdicChangeTensor T c M U 1 x :=
+    (pbcScalarAdjunction_exists c).exists.choose_spec M U x
+  change e.hom.val.app U
+    (((completedAdicChange T c).map
+      ((adicLisseConstantModules T A).map
+        (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulLeft A a)))).val.app U
+          (e.inv.val.app U (1 : S.obj.obj U))) = _
+  rw [constant_unit_inv_one, completed_map_tensor_one, constantGenerator_naturality]
+  change e.hom.val.app U (completedAdicChangeTensor T c M U 1
+    (constantGenerator T (ModuleCat.of A A) U (a * 1))) = _
+  dsimp only [id] at hη
+  rw [mul_one, ← hunit]
+  erw [hη, ← hz]
+  rw [(e.hom.val.app U).hom.map_smul]
+  have he := congrArg (fun f : SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S) ⟶
+      SheafOfModules.unit ((adicLisseForget T).obj S) ↦
+        @id (S.obj.obj U) ((f.val.app U).hom (1 : S.obj.obj U))) e.inv_hom_id
+  change e.hom.val.app U (e.inv.val.app U (1 : S.obj.obj U)) =

+universal-coefficient short exact sequence. Multiplication by the scalar power is monic
+on the next cohomology, since repeated multiplication by the scalar is injective on every

+    (T : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]

+      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map

+        ((pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T d n)).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso q).inv.app

+    CompletedConstantReduction.completedComparison T d.ideal d.quotientFinite

+        c.hom.app U ((adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U (π ^ (n + 1))) :=
+      constant_change_scalar_one T c (π ^ (n + 1)) U
+    have hinjpow : Function.Injective (fun x : H.val.obj U ↦
+        (c.hom.app U ((adicLisseConstantUnit T A).app U π)) ^ (n + 1) • x) := by

+    simpa only [map_pow] using hh

+      (J := ProEt.topology T) (A := pbcAdicCompletion T d) H).map f) := by
+    let eH := ReductionTensor.tensorUnitIso T (pbcAdicCompletion T d) H
+    constructor
+    intro Z g h hgh
+    apply (cancel_mono eH.hom).1
+    apply (cancel_mono μ).1
+    change (g ≫ eH.hom) ≫ (eH.inv ≫ _ ≫ eH.hom) =
+      (h ≫ eH.hom) ≫ (eH.inv ≫ _ ≫ eH.hom)

+      (fun k ↦ k ≫ eH.hom) hgh

+  let S := (pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n)

+    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).map
+        ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction φ).unit.app K) ≫
+      ((pbcRestrict φ).mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso q).inv.app
+        ((pbcDerivedExtend φ).obj K))
+  have : IsIso ((pbcRestrict φ).map v) := hc

+    inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf
+      ((adicLisseForget T).obj (pbcAdicCompletion T d))).map ((pbcRestrict φ).map v)))
+  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso v (SheafOfModules.toSheaf ((adicLisseForget T).obj S))
